# Textarea
Atlas Textarea — multiline input. Variant × Size × State matrix. Mirrors Input semantics; vertical-resize host, top-aligned text. Tokens: surface, border, primary (focus), danger (error), foreground/foreground-muted, radius/md, spacing/2-3-4.

USE WHEN
· Notes, messages, descriptions, or any text that can exceed one line.

DON'T USE WHEN
· The value must stay on one line → Input.

DO
· Pair with a Label whose htmlFor matches the field id.
· Keep resizing vertical; horizontal resizing breaks layouts.
· Show State=error with a visible message, not colour alone.

DON'T
· Hide a character limit that is enforced.
· Use placeholder text as the only label.

PROPERTIES
Variant: default | filled | unstyled. Size: sm | md | lg. State: default | hover | focus-visible | disabled | error.
